entries.zh: 投入冥想、出神（神思飘举而入观想之境）
entries.en: to throw oneself into contemplation; to fall into a trance/absorption

entries.zh: 掷、抛（投掷物件）
entries.en: to throw, to cast (an object)

entries.zh: 掷落水、抛入水中
entries.en: to throw into the water; to cast (something) into the river/sea

entries.zh: 掷过舡、抛上船（把东西扔过船去；或投掷撞船）
entries.en: to throw onto/against a ship; to heave something aboard a vessel

entries.zh: 抛去、扔掉（掷以脱手；去字或作脱手抛出解）
entries.en: to throw away, to fling off (to cast and be rid of)
entries.notes: 去/却字形互证有出入（source_H 作去，M 栏 cag 同音），义定为脱手抛掷，存轻疑。

entries.zh: 掷物（戏而掷之；献字有疑，或为献掷义）
entries.en: to throw, to toss (an object, playfully); [字有疑] perhaps to offer/hand up
entries.notes: source_H 原标 [疑:獻]，字释不定，按西语 arrojar hirando 定为掷义。

entries.zh: 戏掷、投掷东西（戏而抛掷诸物）
entries.en: to throw, to toss things about

entries.zh: 甩掷、抡掷（撣字有疑，或为挨/抡甩之掷）
entries.en: to hurl, to sling (an object)
entries.notes: source_H 原标 [疑:挨]，字形不定；依西语 hirando（甩掷）定义。

entries.zh: 撣（甩掷）石头、掷石
entries.en: to throw a stone; to hurl stones
entries.notes: 字有 [疑] 标但四栏互证（M 栏 ta chio tau + 西语 piedra）清晰。

entries.zh: 却（掷却、抛掷；guastéquere 或指掷弹器具，详见西注）
entries.en: to cast off, to throw (away); note refers to throwing with a guastéquere (grenade-like device)
entries.notes: 西语条目含 guastéquere 一词难确解（疑为投掷武器），主体掷却义四栏清晰。

entries.zh: 却丢、抛掉（急掷脱手）
entries.en: to throw away, to fling off hastily (despechar: to cast off in disgust)

entries.zh: 却掷、抛弃掷却
entries.en: to throw away, to cast off

entries.zh: 摔（掷而摔碎；摔字有疑或为捌）
entries.en: to throw down, to dash (so as to break)
entries.notes: source_H 原标 [疑:捌]，字形不定；西语 quebrando（摔碎）与 M 栏 siag 定义。

entries.zh: 摔破、掷破
entries.en: to throw and break; to dash to pieces
entries.notes: 有 [疑] 标但 M/R 栏 siag pòa / sài pō 与西语互证清晰。

entries.zh: 丢、丢出（抛掷于外）
entries.en: to throw out, to toss away

entries.zh: 丢弃（厌弃而丢开、撒手弃之）
entries.en: to discard, to throw away in disgust; to cast off

entries.zh: 丢却掷、丢却（厌弃抛掷）
entries.en: to throw away, to cast off (in disdain)

entries.zh: 丢东丢西、东抛西掷（乱丢一气）
entries.en: to throw this way and that; to toss things about hither and thither
entries.notes: 西语 una y otra 或为 '一而再' 之截文，按汉字丢东丢西定为主义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语：掷于众人之上）
entries.en: 〔manuscript deficient; sense doubtful〕 (Sp.: to throw upon the others)
entries.notes: 三栏 [空]，仅西语词头 arrojar sovre losotros（掷向众人）可循。

entries.zh: 丢向、掷向某人某物（丢坬字有疑）
entries.en: to throw at, to hurl toward (someone or something)
entries.notes: source_H 有 [疑] 标且 R 栏 T99 污损难辨，仅据 M 栏 hiū quē 与西语定向掷义。

entries.zh: 射、发射（射掷投石；piecra 疑为 piedra 投石之讹）
entries.en: to shoot, to cast (a stone/projectile)

entries.zh: 射着、投中（射而中的）
entries.en: to hit the mark, to strike the target (in throwing/shooting)

entries.zh: 射出头、掷石而中（掷石而中的；出字 R 栏污损）
entries.en: to throw a stone and hit the mark
entries.notes: M 栏 cheu 有 T99 污损标注，但汉字射出头与西语互证清晰。

entries.zh: 摽（掷、抛掷；摽字有疑或为标）
entries.en: to throw, to cast (a missile)
entries.notes: source_H 原标 [疑:標]，且西语条目文字残乱（recua rectia 难解），依音与掷义定。

entries.zh: 摽上去、抛掷上去（掷而向上）
entries.en: to throw up, to cast upward (toward those above)
entries.notes: 有 [疑] 标且 M 栏 cau 有 T99 污损；R 栏 guīe siāng gùi 与汉字摽上去互证定掷上义。
